definitions.bus_stop_density_per_sq_km: bus and trolleybus stops within 800 m, divided by circular catchment area
definitions.nearby_bus_route_count: distinct route_ref values recorded on bus stops within 800 m
definitions.bus_centrality_score: bounded combination of local bus-stop density and distinct nearby route count
